source_value.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: this is an official Microsoft screen recording of Power BI Desktop on Windows that plays itself. Inside it the pointer is driven for the viewer — it rests beside "Get data" in the welcome dialog at 15-17s, presses "Load sample data" at 48.0-48.5s, and opens the ribbon's Data Type list at 85.5-86.5s — and red editorial annotations are drawn over the recording (a red rule next to "Get data" at 15-17s, a red rectangle around the ribbon's Data group at ~18s).
source_value.start_state: White Microsoft four-square splash on the Windows desktop (0-3s), which becomes the "Untitled - Power BI Desktop" window carrying the Power BI Desktop welcome dialog (about 4-17.5s).
source_value.end_state: Power Query Editor with the Units Sold column converted and highlighted, Queries [1] listing "financials", and APPLIED STEPS Source / Navigation / Changed Type in the Query Settings pane (88-90s).
source_value.continuity: One 90.03s recording at 30 fps (2701 frames), continuous within each scene rather than cut together: the welcome dialog disappears between 17.5s and 18.0s to uncover the empty "Add data to your report" canvas, a "Connecting" progress modal appears and clears between 49.0s and 50.0s, and the Navigator dialog opens empty at 50.5s ("No items selected for preview") then populates its tree "Financial Sample.xlsx [2]" > financials, Sheet1 by 51.0s and its preview grid of financials rows by 54s. No still-image interpolation.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: The Power BI Desktop welcome dialog is dismissed between 17.5s and 18.0s, uncovering the empty report canvas behind it, and is never reopened. At 87.0-87.5s the "Change Column Type" prompt offers "Replace current", "Add new step" and "Cancel" for an existing type conversion; the recording takes the replace path, so no cancellation, undo or back-navigation is performed anywhere in the clip.
source_value.feedback: Every committed action draws a visible answer in the same frame: pressing "Load sample data" at 48.5s closes the modal and raises a "Connecting" progress modal with a Cancel button at 49.5s; checking the financials item in the Navigator fills the preview grid with rows (54-66s); the Power Query status bar reports "16 COLUMNS, 700 ROWS" with "Column profiling based on top 1000 rows" and "PREVIEW DOWNLOADED AT 10:39 AM" (state-03 at 75.6s); and each transform appends a named entry to APPLIED STEPS (Source, Navigation, Changed Type).
